dataList.name: Mauled Color [Rouge]
dataList.desc:
- Stack Maks: 9
- Ketika diserang, peroleh 1 Potency Bleed untuk setiap 3 Stack (sekali per giliran)
- Akhir Giliran: Peroleh 1 Defense Level Down giliran berikutnya untuk setiap 4 Stack (maks 2)
- Akhir Giliran: Kehilangan 1 Stack
dataList.flavor: 'Some say that the Ring's paint is made dari the same base material as Augmentation Tattoos—they are both nigh-indelible pigments that terima considerable effort to erase, let alone bleach.'

dataList.name: Mauled Color [Bleu]
dataList.desc:
- Stack Maks: 9
- Ketika diserang, peroleh 1 Sinking Potency untuk setiap 3 Stack (sekali per giliran)
- Akhir Giliran: Pada 5+ Stack, kehilangan 5 SP
- Akhir Giliran: Kehilangan 1 Stack
dataList.flavor: 'Jika the Middle uses their tattoos for self-augmentation, does that make the Ring's tattoos tambahan brands that, when forcibly applied, weaken their musuh?'

dataList.name: Touche Hardie
dataList.desc:
- Selama unit ini memiliki efek ini, double jumlah dari HP dan SP damage unit ini menerima dari Bleed dan Sinking
- Akhir Giliran: Kehilangan 1 Stack
- Stack Maks: 1
dataList.flavor: "Wolven claws, lynx claws... dan even those of turtles, so minuscule yet intricately arranged... What a bold expression."

dataList.name: Palette Vibrante
dataList.desc:
- Terima +(Stack x 5)% damage dari The Ring-faction unit
· Jika the penyerang is in The Ring School of Fauvism faction, terima +(Stack x 10)% damage saja
- Awal Pertempuran: Peroleh (Stack +1) Bleed, Sinking, Bleed Count, dan Sinking Count
- Akhir Pertempuran: Efek ini kadaluarsa. Setengahkan Mauled Color [Rouge] dan Mauled Color [Bleu] Stack on unit ini (dibulatkan ke bawah)
- Stack Maks: 4

dataList.name: Le Fauvisme - Masque de Loup
dataList.desc:
- Min & Maks Speed +1
- Beri +1 tambahan Bleed dan Sinking Potency dengan Skill
- Before hitting, jika target tidak memiliki Sinking, beri +2 Sinking Count (sekali per Sinner per giliran)
- Sebelum Terkena Serangan, jika target tidak memiliki Bleed, beri +2 Bleed Count (sekali per Sinner per giliran)
dataList.flavor:
"One might ask: What even distinguishes les Fauves dari factions such as Heishous, R Corp. Packs, dan tambahan that incorporate beasts menjadi their identities?"

"A reasonable query, of that there is no doubt; to that I say we are distinguished sebanyak the transcendence of beastliness menjadi artistic costumery, while the Heishous have mindlessly jammed it menjadi their anatomies, disregarding their aesthetic qualities."

dataList.name: Le Fauvisme - Masque de Loup Ensanglanté
dataList.desc:
- Beri +20% damage; ubah semua Coin menjadi Unbreakable Coin
- Min & Maks Speed +1
- Beri +1 tambahan dari efek negatif berikut dengan Skill
· Potency Bleed dan Count
· Sinking Potency dan Count
- Before hitting, jika target tidak memiliki Sinking, beri +2 Sinking Count (3 kali per Sinner per giliran)
- Sebelum Terkena Serangan, jika target tidak memiliki Bleed, beri +2 Bleed Count (3 kali per Sinner per giliran)
dataList.flavor:
One tidak dapat simply awaken the power of one's inner ferity sebanyak donning a beastly mask.
The interior dari setiap headgear worn sebanyak these artists is lined with a mat of needles dipped in the Fauvist paint, which is injected menjadi the body upon equipment. 

Thus is the paint of the Ring—dan these artists, tidak peduli dengan their School, are semua bound untuk menggunakan it.

dataList.name: Prescript: [Paper Slip] I
dataList.desc:
Attack dan hit a Sinner.

- Awal Giliran: Pada 0~2 Grace of the Prescript, peroleh efek ini
- Maximum stackable Grace of the Prescript with this Prescript is limited to 3
dataList.flavor: The Prescripts are delivered sebanyak many means, their medium determined with finality akin to divine prophecy. Those who menerima them hold no power over how they arrive.

dataList.name: Karmic Consequence
dataList.desc:
- Awal Giliran:
· Peroleh 1 Defense Level Down untuk setiap 10 Stack
· Peroleh 1 Fragile untuk setiap 20 Stack
- Stack Maks: 100
dataList.flavor: Receive the Prescript dan undertake it. Its execution is etched as karma, drawn menjadi a ceaseless cycle that circles back to the hand of its executor.
